name: Huffman Coding
description: Notes on prefix-free variable-length codes, and an implementation that builds a Huffman tree and compresses a paragraph of text from 4,592 to 2,535 bits.
highlights: Why frequent characters get shorter codewords, with a worked 100,000-character example
Greedy tree construction by repeatedly merging the two rarest nodes
Recursive code generation: left edge = 0, right edge = 1
